metricDefinitions.raw deaths/wounded: Mean physical counts per combat by identity and unit; wounded are survivors classified after resolution.
metricDefinitions.projected deaths/wounded/prisoners: Mean post-combat consequences per combat; do not add to raw counts.
metricDefinitions.bench_economic_loss_rate: Profile cost times projected dead plus projected wounded, divided by actual initial army cost; prisoners excluded; not a care invoice.
metricDefinitions.wilson_attacker_low/high: Marginal 95% Wilson interval for attacker win probability, conditional on this fixed setup and sampling protocol.

limitations: Batch data contain only sums/counts, not per-combat distributions, quantiles, covariance or paired differences.
The same nominal base seed does not by itself prove independent or paired samples across scenarios.
Repeated identical effective requests across plans are aliases, not new independent combats.
